summary: The diff adds a new CameraCaptureDialog with a live camera preview and capture-to-ExternalBlob flow, plus localStorage-backed quality/facingMode preferences, and wires a camera capture action into InspectionForm. However, device-specific camera selection (by video input deviceId) is not evidenced/likely incomplete, an explicit fallback-to-upload path on permission denial is not evidenced, and an immutable auth hook file was modified contrary to constraints. Some meta/project tracking files were also added without being requested.

missing_requirements.requirement: The capture modal provides a "Camera" setting to switch between available video input devices when more than one camera is available (e.g., front/back cameras).
missing_requirements.reason: Although device enumeration state exists, the camera hook is invoked with only `facingMode` (no `deviceId` constraint), and no evidence shows selecting a specific device and applying it to camera constraints.

missing_requirements.requirement: If camera permission is denied/unavailable, show an English error message and provide a fallback path to upload files instead.
missing_requirements.reason: An English permission-denied error string is present, but the diff excerpt does not show any UI/action that provides a fallback path to the existing file upload flow (e.g., button/link to upload).

hallucinated_features.description: Modified an immutable auth/actor hook file (`frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts`) even though the BuildRequest explicitly forbids modifying it.
hallucinated_features.reason: This change is outside the requested camera feature work and violates the stated constraint to not modify immutable auth/actor hook files.

hallucinated_features.description: Added project tracking/state artifacts (`project_state.json`, `frontend-file-summaries.txt`) that are not part of the requested camera capture/settings functionality.
hallucinated_features.reason: These files are not requested by any requirement or acceptance criteria and do not appear necessary to implement the feature.
